description: The estate on one screen: health, traffic, services, memory, logs, capacity and changes. Grafana's home dashboard.

panels.description: Four checks, 25 points each: every node Ready (kube-state-metrics), every Argo CD application Synced and Healthy (argocd_app_info), Vault unsealed (vault_core_unsealed), and no alert firing (Grafana's rules, grafana_alerting_alerts, plus Prometheus's, ALERTS).

targets.expr: 25 * (((sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"})) == bool (count(kube_node_info))) + ((count(argocd_app_info{sync_status="Synced", health_status="Healthy"}) or vector(0)) == bool (count(argocd_app_info))) + ((max(vault_core_unsealed{job="vault-active"})) == bool 1) + (((sum(grafana_alerting_alerts{state="alerting"}) or vector(0)) + (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}) or vector(0))) == bool 0))

(25 * (((sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"})) == bool (count(kube_node_info))) + ((count(argocd_app_info{sync_status="Synced", health_status="Healthy"}) or vector(0)) == bool (count(argocd_app_info))) + ((max(vault_core_unsealed{job="vault-active"})) == bool 1) + (((sum(grafana_alerting_alerts{state="alerting"}) or vector(0)) + (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}) or vector(0))) == bool 0))) == bool 100

(25 * (((sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"})) == bool (count(kube_node_info))) + ((count(argocd_app_info{sync_status="Synced", health_status="Healthy"}) or vector(0)) == bool (count(argocd_app_info))) + ((max(vault_core_unsealed{job="vault-active"})) == bool 1) + (((sum(grafana_alerting_alerts{state="alerting"}) or vector(0)) + (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}) or vector(0))) == bool 0))) >= bool 50

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Every request Traefik's entrypoints took (websecure and internal). The delta is the change across the range.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: 5xx responses as a share of every request at the entrypoints.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time Traefik's services took to answer.

panels.title: Sites up · 30 d
panels.description: The public sites (offby1.cc, artistlabco.com): requests that did not end in a 5xx over the last 30 days, at Traefik.

panels.title: Pods not running
panels.description: Pods Pending, Failed or Unknown (kube-state-metrics). 0 is a real count.

panels.title: Volumes degraded
panels.description: Longhorn volumes degraded or faulted, each counted once. A detached volume reports unknown and is not counted. 0 is a real count.

panels.title: Estate
panels.description: 2 hosts · 3 pools · 6 cluster nodes · 7 guests outside the cluster. CPU and memory from node-exporter, pods running and Ready from kube-state-metrics. The placement is the pools' (0xc0.cc/pool); the guests outside the cluster report nothing here.

text.fixed: Layer 2 only for the zones; no Longhorn replicas here.

panels.title: Traffic
panels.description: Requests per second over the range, entrypoint to service. websecure is the public tunnel (blue), internal is WARP only (amber). The service is Traefik's backend, <namespace>-<service>.
